description: "Captains of Industry; or, Men of Business Who Did Something Besides Making…" by James Parton is a historical account written in the late 19th century. The book explores the lives and contributions of prominent American businessmen who not only achieved financial success but also made significant societal impacts through their work and philanthropy.
